description.value: Gain one Deadhand class feat of 6th level or lower — any of the four 2nd-level general options listed under Basic Trade, the 4th-level general options Contract Terms, Never Flat, Take It Standing and Worked Through Worse, the 6th-level general options Deep Tally, Read the Killer, Trade Up and Walk It Off, plus any 2nd-, 4th- or 6th-level feat of the Trade you named with Chosen Trade. You may take this feat more than once, choosing a different feat each time.
